hero.headline: Help Us Build the Silicon Savannah
hero.subheadline: We are hiring for our Phase 1 and Phase 2 expansion. Join a team dedicated to making Africa a global AI powerhouse.

sections.title: Current Opportunities for Innovators
sections.body: As we scale our 1MW facility, we are looking for specialists across the technical and operational spectrum. We need hands-on engineers who understand high-density power and cooling, as well as digital architects who can manage global network fabrics. Our current hiring focus is on building our core Nairobi team to manage day-to-day operations, alongside a distributed team of developers and analysts. We offer competitive international salaries, equity opportunities, and the chance to work at the absolute cutting edge of the infrastructure industry. If you thrive in a high-stakes, mission-driven environment where technical precision is the top priority, we want to hear from you. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confidence.
